sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.5.1
- Product changes made in your admin panel now show up on your site right away.
- The clubs page no longer briefly says "No club memberships" while it loads.
- Club address forms now point out exactly which fields need attention.
- Customizing a club shipment is smoother: cards and addresses save on their own, and pickup orders no longer ask for a ship date.
- Wine clubs a customer already belongs to are clearly labeled, with a matching join button.
- Styling Studio: pick Google Fonts for each heading level, choose how many columns your store grid shows, and turn store filters on or off.
